ctx.x: And he called it the Cotton Club?
He called it the Cotton Club. And it closed, you know, but he was a Basie lover and a blues lover, and so he opened with Basie and Pearl Bailey.
And that was -- they were working opposite the Hollywood Empire, which was down the street and around he corner from Vine Street where Duke Ellington was.
